identitySignals: Name matches 'Black Earth Farms', a Black and Indigenous led agroecology collective in Oakland, CA (CAFF farm directory)

Search results (not fetched pages) describe a Black Earth collective as a partner of the Castlemont High School farm, consistent with the 'Castlemont High School' agreement, but this was not confirmed on a fetched page
research.notes: Agenda gives Davis, CA but every source places Black Earth Farms in Oakland; the mismatch is unexplained. No nonprofit or California Secretary of State registry record was found. The domain blackearthfarms.com (listed by CAFF) now 301-redirects to an unrelated-looking domain (pafisorong.org, returns 403), so the website and listed email were not used. Castlemont partnership not confirmed on any fetched page. Not safe to publish.

profile.summary: Black Earth Farms describes itself as a Black and Indigenous led agroecology collective in the Oakland, California area. It says it trains community members in chemical-free, community-run food systems in urban areas and grows vegetables and fruit.

sources.title: Black Earth Farms - Community Alliance with Family Farmers
